description: Public fictitious test vectors; no production identifiers, keys, data or payment operation.

files.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON + LF per line
files.name: events.jsonl

fixture_key_material.classification: PUBLIC_FIXTURE only: these public strings are test vectors, not credentials.
fixture_key_material.encoding: Literal ASCII bytes; no hex/base64 decoding or trailing newline.

reproduction.aggregate_jsonl_order: First batch events in batch order, followed by second batch events; three lines total.
reproduction.batch_signature: Remove sig; HMAC-SHA256 over canonical JSON bytes without LF; lower-case hexadecimal digest.
reproduction.canonical_json: UTF-8, recursively sorted map keys, list order retained, no whitespace or escaped slashes. All vector numbers are integers.
reproduction.commission_reference: com_ or aff_ plus first 32 hex characters of HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical object {schema,origin,store,kind,source_id} using the public pseudonym fixture key.
reproduction.event_id: cev_ plus SHA-256 of canonical event with revision and without event_id, without LF.
reproduction.events_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical event + LF for each event in that batch, ordered ascending by event_id.
reproduction.file_bytes: Canonical JSON plus one LF. SHA-256 covers all file bytes including LF.
reproduction.revision: SHA-256 of canonical event without revision and event_id, without LF.
reproduction.scenario: First batch observes BRL 12.34 pending and BRL 56.78 active. Second batch observes the same BRL 12.34 commission becoming active; the BRL 56.78 commission is unchanged and emits no new event.

wire_key_id_note: The label is descriptive. The wire ID uses the existing closed /^k_[a-z0-9]{1,16}$/ schema.
